proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL chādana gives Oriya chāāṇa/chāaṇi thatching, then explicitly explains replacement by a Middle IA causative-stem formation in -āpana: Prakrit chāvaṇa covering, Bengali/Maithili chāuni thatch, Oriya chāuṇi huts and Gujarati chāvaṇ thatch/chāvṇī huts. The cauni/chavani roof responses fit that documented replacement family. Canonical node 5017 includes this unnumbered formation; this is not a claim of simple phonetic descent from unsuffixed chādana. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: chāvəṇi.
